privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: When a client asks, you can give them a copy of their data or erase their personal details.
privacy.eraseExplain: Name, email, phone, date of birth and notes are erased, health declarations are deleted, upcoming bookings are cancelled and the client app account is unlinked. Bookings, plans and payments stay (payments must be kept for accounting), under "Deleted client". This can't be undone.
